candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false at the end instead of true, altering the observable return value.
Invert the returned boolean: return the negation of the original true (i.e., return !true), which yields false.
Return the success status of the last low-level external call instead of a hardcoded true, making return value depend on external call outcome.
Replace the low-level call to use call{value:0}(...), changing the call semantics (still no value sent but different opcode encoding).
Replace the low-level call with a call that forwards all remaining gas using gasleft(), altering call gas semantics.
Replace the call with a staticcall, making external calls read-only and likely changing observable effects on the external contract invoked.
Replace the call with a delegatecall, executing target code in this contract's context thus altering state effects observable here.
Replace the low-level call with an explicit require on its success, causing transfer to revert if any external call fails.
